title: Rational functor comparison by tensor naturality
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l different from D.p, a proper scheme Y over its geometric field, a compactification c of the structure map, and a finite extension E/Q_l [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-proper-morphism]. The recorded rational compact-support functors [def-weil-compact-support-finite-action] for c and for the identity compactification are naturally isomorphic on the raw rational constructible category [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi].

source.place: first paragraph: identity compactification and passage through coefficients

proof.text: Compose the integral ambient comparison for c with the inverse comparison for the identity compactification. Both have the same completed ordinary target. Lift its components and naturality through the full constructible subcategory.

Apply raw localization to each component and its inverse. On a pure tensor r tensor f, the two naturality composites are r tensor (F(f) followed by alpha) and r tensor (alpha followed by G(f)); integral naturality identifies them. Tensor induction handles zero and sums. The localized inverse equations give inverse natural transformations.

proof_origin.place: expanded coefficient passage and recorded-value identifications

theorem properCompactRationalFunctorComparison
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of D.k))]
    [IsProper (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of D.k))]
    (c : Compactification (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of D.k)))
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] :
    letI : (Spec (CommRingCat.of D.k)).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of D.k)) := ⟨𝟙 _⟩
    Nonempty (sfCompactSupportFiniteFunctor l D.k (finiteFieldDatumPrimeUnit D l hl)
        c E ≅ sfCompactSupportFiniteFunctor l D.k (finiteFieldDatumPrimeUnit D l hl)
        (Compactification.ofIsProper (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))) E)
